notes.title: Discover the Secrets of Velendar Castle
notes.notes: [p][i]The king has taken you prisoner. Your house was burned, and your mother, your only family, executed under his commands. But you committed no crime… What does he want from you?[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4016880/Secrets_of_Velendar_Castle__Escape_Room/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hint added towards the end
notes.notes: One of the puzzles relied on the musical ear of the player and was nearly impossible to some people, so a visual cue has been added.

notes.title: Don't forget to leave a review!
notes.notes: [p]Reviews help greatly with the initial reception of the game on the platform. Be it positive or negative, it's always positive for Secrets of Blackrock Manor to leave a review![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Improved performance
notes.notes: The game was not performing as well as it could on the high quality setting. After some adjustments, it now runs a lot smoother.
